function.name: electromagnetism_ampere_law
function.description: Calculate magnetic field strength using Ampere's Circuital Law. Input the current enclosed by a circular path and the distance from the center of the circle. Can be applied to a cylindrical or spherical symmetry of consistent magnetic field.  Unlike electromagnetism_biot_savart_law, which calculates magnetic field strength using the Biot-Savart law, this calculates magnetic field strength using Ampere's Circuital Law.

enclosed_current.description: The total current enclosed by the loop. In Amperes. This is a float type value.

radius.description: The radius of the circle or the distance from the center of the circular path. In meters. This is a float type value.

mu0.description: Permeability of free space. Its value is default approximated to be 0.000001256 H/m. Optional This is a float type value.

function.name: electromagnetism_biot_savart_law
function.description: Calculate magnetic field strength using Biot-Savart law. Input the current in Ampere and the distance in meters. Unlike electromagnetism_ampere_law, which calculates magnetic field strength using Ampere's Circuital Law, this calculates magnetic field strength using the Biot-Savart law.

current.description: The current in the conductor, in Amperes.

distance.description: Distance from the current carrying conductor, in meters.

mu0.description: Permeability of free space. Its value is default approximated to be 0.000001256 H/m. Optional This is a float type value.
